slats.fit: Choose a real section first; calculate whole slat count and center the remainder. Drop a secondary field before reducing details below fabrication limits.
slats.quantity: Count × actual length; backing net area; fixings separately.

moulding.fit: Split at doors/windows, fit whole rectangular bays within each clear segment; never stretch profile cross sections.
moulding.quantity: Sum actual profile path lengths; corner/joint counts and cutting waste separately.

niche.fit: Unknown existing wall construction means build outward or omit. A semicircular arch has radius half clear width; account for reveals and linings.
niche.quantity: Back + returns + soffit + shelf surfaces, framing and substrate; subtract opening from front face.

slab.fit: Use actual sheet/slab sizes and transport constraints; add seams instead of inventing an unlimited slab. Bookmatching only when material supply supports it.
slab.quantity: Net cladding area plus separately calculated fabrication yield, returns and edges.

light.fit: Use a real channel and assembly. Conceal the source from normal sightlines; maintain access to power components.
light.quantity: Actual lit path, channel and diffuser lengths; drivers/connectors from electrical design.

panel.fit: Reflow modules around openings and access panels; do not stretch texture or relief pitch.
panel.quantity: Net area, module count, joint/edge length and substrate separately.

cladding.fit: Preserve real module scale and edge conditions; select interior/exterior assembly before generating geometry.
cladding.quantity: Net area, corners, cuts and support assembly.

mural.fit: Crop or repeat deliberately, never distort the motif to fill a wall; avoid slicing key artwork at openings.
mural.quantity: Supplier roll or custom-print layout including pattern matching, not only net wall area.

tile.fit: Lay out actual tile modules with balanced end cuts; align niche/fixture edges where feasible.
tile.quantity: Tile counts/cuts, trim lengths, substrate, adhesive and grout separately.
